title: Fire & HazMat Dispatch Activity — 2025
intro:
During 2025, the Beckley-Raleigh County 911 Center received and coordinated responses to a variety of reported fire-related and hazardous materials incidents throughout Raleigh County. The categories displayed represent the initial nature of the incidents as reported to the communications center at the time the calls were received.

It is important to note that the initial reported nature of an incident may differ from the circumstances ultimately encountered or determined by responding personnel. Call classifications may change as additional information becomes available and responders investigate the situation.

This breakdown illustrates the variety of reported incidents for which the center coordinated emergency response resources throughout the year and classified as potential hazardous materials related incidents.
